title: How to (Accidentally) Tell Real Money from Rented Money in Dubai. Tip #1
body: Rented Lamborghini on Sheikh Zayed Road, apartment in JVC, ring light in the corner. Actual money is a white Patrol, a villa in Dubai Hills, and nothing posted anywhere since 2019. The loud one is working very hard. The quiet one stopped needing to. It's a sealed deal when you realise the man with the supercar has twelve cheques and the man with the Patrol paid one.
caption:
Tip #1 😭 the rented Lambo era needs to end.

title: How to (Accidentally) Tell Real Money from Rented Money in Dubai. Tip #2
body: Ask what they do and count the words. "I'm in business" with no noun attached is a red flag in every city but especially this one. Real answers are boring: "we do logistics," "my father imports steel," "we have three restaurants." It's a sealed deal if the answer is dull, specific, and they change the subject because it genuinely does not interest them.

Tip #2 😭 the rented Lambo era needs to end.

title: How to (Accidentally) Tell Real Money from Rented Money in Dubai. Tip #3
body: Check the watch and then check the wrist it's on. Anyone can wear a Rolex in this city, half of Karama will sell you one. The tell is a man in a plain shirt whose watch you didn't notice for an hour. It's a sealed deal if the expensive thing in the room is the one nobody has mentioned.

title: How to (Accidentally) Tell Real Money from Rented Money in Dubai. Tip #4
body: Look at where the photos are taken, because Dubai is designed to make anyone look rich for one afternoon. The Burj in the background, a rented yacht at Marina, a hotel lobby anyone can walk into. Real money's photos are in a house you cannot identify. It's a sealed deal if their grid has no landmarks in it at all.

Tip #4 😭 the rented Lambo era needs to end.

title: How to (Accidentally) Tell Real Money from Rented Money in Dubai. Tip #5
body: Ask about the visa, because it's the one thing that cannot be rented. Golden visa, or a trade licence in their own name, or a family business older than they are. Someone posting from a Marina apartment on an employment visa is one HR decision from leaving. It's a sealed deal if their name is on a licence issued before 2010.

Tip #5 😭 the rented Lambo era needs to end.

title: How to (Accidentally) Tell Real Money from Rented Money in Dubai. Tip #6
body: Watch what happens in summer. The performance stops in July because there is nobody here to perform for. The ones who actually have money leave for two months. The ones who don't post the same six locations in forty-eight degrees. It's a sealed deal if the account goes quiet from June and comes back in September with no explanation.
caption:
Tip #6 😭 the rented Lambo era needs to end.

title: How to (Accidentally) Tell Real Money from Rented Money in Dubai. Tip #7
body: Ask where they eat on an ordinary Tuesday. Everyone posts Zuma and Nusr-Et once. The honest answer is Ravi in Satwa, or a karak spot in Al Quoz, or their mother's kitchen. It's a sealed deal if a family with real money still drives to Satwa at midnight and has done it for twenty years.

title: How to (Accidentally) Tell Real Money from Rented Money in Dubai. Tip #8
body: The final tell is how they talk about money at all. The ones who have it are boring about it, or silent, or slightly embarrassed. The ones who don't will tell you what things cost, unprompted, within the first hour. It's a sealed deal when somebody mentions a number and everyone at the table quietly recalculates who they're dealing with.

Tip #8 😭 the rented Lambo era needs to end.
